Estimate genetic covariance of strata

Source: R/compute_gencov.R
compute_gencov.Rd

Compute genetic covariances and correlations between case strata using SumHer. This is the second step in the StratGWAS workflow.

Usage

compute_gencov(
  strata,
  filename,
  nr_blocks = 1000,
  outfile,
  cov = NULL,
  lds = NULL,
  ss_list = NULL,
  alpha = -0.25,
  jack = TRUE,
  B = 50
)

Arguments

strata

An object returned from stratify

filename

Prefix of genotype .bed file (without the .bed extension)

nr_blocks

Block size for reading in genotype data (default: 1000)

outfile

Name/path prefix for output files

cov

Optional: covariates in PLINK format (FID, IID, then covariates). Missing values are imputed by the column mean, and covariates are regressed out of each stratum before the GWAS.

lds

Optional: data frame containing LD scores. The first column should contain SNP IDs, while the second column contains LD scores. If NULL, LD scores will be computed from genotype data (using a random subset of 1000 individuals if N > 1000).

ss_list

Optional: list of previously computed summary statistics for strata in strata$multi

alpha

Selection parameter for dependency MAF on SNP heritability (default: -0.25)

jack

Logical specifying whether jack-knife estimates are used to compute h2 standard errors (default: FALSE)

B

Number of jackknife blocks for standard error of genetic covariance (default: 50)

Value

Returns a list containing:

gencov

Genetic covariance matrix between strata

gencor

Genetic correlation matrix between strata

hers

Vector of SNP heritabilities for each stratum

var_names

Names of variables/strata

strat_details

Detailed stratification information from input

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic usage
data(pheno)
data(strat_cont)
filename_bed <- system.file("extdata", "data.bed", package = "StratGWAS")
filename <- gsub(".bed", "", filename_bed)
outfile <- tempfile("gencov")

strata <- stratify(pheno, strat_cont = strat_cont, K = 5)
gencov <- compute_gencov(strata, filename, nr_blocks = 1000, outfile)

# Examine results
print(gencov$gencov)  # Genetic covariance matrix
print(gencov$gencor)  # Genetic correlation matrix
print(gencov$hers)    # SNP heritabilities


} # }
